def config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str:
    """Value for `key` in `name=value` per-line config text, or "" when the key is absent.

    Lines are split on the first "=". Names and values are stripped of
    surrounding whitespace. Blank lines, comment lines starting with "#"
    and lines without "=" are ignored. If a key appears more than once,
    the first occurrence wins.
    """
    ex config_value("a=1\nb=2", "b") == "2"
    ex config_value("a=1\nb=2", "c") == ""
    ex config_value("# c\n a = x y \na=z", "a") == "x y"
    ex config_value("", "a") == ""
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if line == "" or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        name, sep, val = line.partition("=")
        if sep == "":
            continue
        if name.strip() == key:
            return val.strip().copy()
    return ""
